title: shotlist/1
description: Maps an episode's script lines to shots. File: bible/series/<series>/episodes/<ep>/shotlist.json (written by the director, Opus). Read by tools/compose.py. Each shot is a tools/shot.py shot folder; frames are the shot render's frame numbers at the shotlist fps. A transition of N frames overlaps the two shots by N/fps seconds, so it shortens the episode by that much. Spoken lines are placed on the episode timeline and may cross cuts (see `lines`). Times in `lines[].at_s`, `faces[].t0/t1`, `sfx[].t` are seconds from the START of the shot (after in_frame).

profile.description: Gate profile (tools/qg_checks.py format_of). `calm` selects the calm-format gates (kb/quality/gate-spec.md section H); the never-a-slideshow motion and cut thresholds stay for `premium`. The `format` key above is the schema id, so the profile has its own key.

wrapper.description: Calm format: where the recurring wrapper sits on the episode clock, seconds. Required parts: recap (inside the first 3 s), day_card, choice_card (inside the last 20 s), follow_card (after the choice card).

canvas.description: [1080, 1920] for a real episode; safe zones are fractions of it.

event.description: The story event or the story's question that lands in the first 2 s (reels.md section 2).

hook.description: EP-HOOK: event declared at or before 2.0 s, plus measured motion in the first shot.

video.description: Render path inside the folder; default out/<folder name>.mp4.

out_frame.description: Exclusive. Must be greater than in_frame.

lines.description: Lines that START in this shot. A line is placed on the episode timeline and may run across cuts (J-cut, L-cut); the shot is only where it starts.

line.description: id of a line in script.json

at_s.description: Seconds from the start of this shot to the start of the line. Negative = J-cut (the sound starts in the shot before). PLAN-LINE-TIMELINE: the line must lie inside the episode. Voice first: when the shot's spec has a voice_lines entry for the line, the offset comes from it (start_s minus in_frame/fps) and at_s may be left out; a stated at_s must agree with it (PLAN-VOICE-OFFSET). Without a spec entry at_s is required.

est_dur_s.description: Used only until the take exists (no voice yet).

on_screen.description: false = the speaker is not shown for this line (off-screen voice, cutaway, POV insert): no visemes are applied and PLAN-LIPSYNC asks for no shot.

visible_in.description: Shot ids where the speaker is visible and facing camera while the line plays; the visemes apply only there. PLAN-LIPSYNC: with on_screen true, at least one must overlap the line in time.

overlap_with.description: Ids of lines of a DIFFERENT speaker this line deliberately talks over (declared crosstalk). Undeclared overlap fails PLAN-LINE-OVERLAP.

note.description: Director's note; start with TODO for an unknown.

box.description: x0,y0,x1,y1 in canvas px; from the shot's camera plan.

cause.description: Why the cut or wipe happens here (a story reason).

transitions.description: One entry per neighbouring pair; a plain cut is type cut, frames 0.

sfx_map.description: Maps a shot spec's emotion_track.sfx `what` text to a licensed file. Spec cues with no entry here are reported as unfilled (a warning, not a failure).

gain_db.description: Offset from the -23 LUFS bed level.

backdrop.description: END-CARD: what sits behind the choice card. live-loop (default) plays the last piece's final loop_s seconds forward and back under a scrim, so the picture never freezes; live-hold holds its last frame; static is the old flat card (only for a tiny proof).

loop_s.description: live-loop: seconds of the last piece looped (forward then back).

end_card.description: EP-CHOICE: the viewer's two choices (series.md episode engine), a comment prompt, Thmanyah, inside the safe zone.
